retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome group portrait featuring subjects in wide-brimmed hats with metallic gold display typography and a vertical reflection effect.
triggerTerms: monochrome group portrait with wide brim hats
gold serif typography on black and white photo
low key studio lighting group shot
excludeWhen: candid or outdoor natural lighting is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A tightly framed, low-key monochrome composition of five women wearing black wide-brimmed hats and dark clothing, anchored by a large gold-gradient serif title at the bottom that features a mirrored reflection.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast black and white skin tones against deep black backgrounds
Overlapping subjects creating a dense, triangular group hierarchy
Metallic gold typography providing the sole color accent
Symmetrical reflection of text at the bottom edge
coreInvariants: Black wide-brimmed hats on all subjects
Monochrome photographic treatment for the subjects
Gold gradient texture on the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects arranged in a tiered, overlapping formation filling the frame from top to bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central subject's face and the large gold typography at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular movement between the faces, eventually settling on the bright gold text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with subjects against a dark, vignetted background.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation for the image; high value contrast in the metallic text gradient.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying scales and tracking for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant fashion aesthetic.
Provides the necessary sharp serifs and modern feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio portrait of five women in black wide-brimmed hats, arranged in a tiered group composition with low-key lighting and a dark background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, centered uppercase text in a gold metallic gradient at the bottom, using a high-contrast serif font, and include a vertical mirrored reflection of the text below it.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a gold metallic gradient?
Is there a mirrored reflection of the text at the bottom?
Are all subjects wearing wide-brimmed hats?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Brand logos or specific jewelry designs
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Verify the gold text is legible against the dark background
Ensure the reflection is vertically aligned with the source text
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Studio Group + Wide Brim Hats + Gold Modern Serif + Mirrored Reflection
